name: synthetic
description: Synthetic stress shapes from make_synthetic.py (run it first).

cases.name: sphere
cases.note: smooth convex baseline

cases.name: cube
cases.note: sharp convex edges and corners, 12 large triangles

cases.name: cube_rotated
cases.note: sharp edges not aligned with the octree

cases.name: cube_rotated_gapsnap
cases.note: sharp edges not aligned with the octree; featureGapSnap 0.75 (one more vertex per gap along convex edges)

cases.name: cube_aligned
cases.note: faces lie exactly on octree grid planes (degenerate cuts)

cases.name: cylinder
cases.note: curved face meeting flat caps at sharp rims

cases.name: duct_patches
cases.note: ASCII multi-solid: inlet/outlet/walls patches

cases.name: l_bracket
cases.note: one long concave (re-entrant) edge

cases.name: stepped_shaft
cases.note: concave and convex circular rims

cases.name: star_prism
cases.note: acute convex spikes (36 deg) and reflex edges

cases.name: star_prism_gapsnap
cases.note: acute convex spikes (36 deg) and reflex edges; featureGapSnap 0.75 (one more vertex per gap along convex edges)

cases.name: cone_tip
cases.note: point singularity at the apex

cases.name: cone_tip_gapsnap
cases.note: point singularity at the apex; featureGapSnap 0.75 (one more vertex per gap along convex edges)

cases.name: wedge_10deg
cases.note: fluid wedge closing to a 10 deg knife edge

cases.name: torus
cases.note: genus 1

cases.name: shell_nested
cases.note: fluid between two nested spheres (inner surface inverted)

cases.name: two_spheres
cases.note: two disjoint fluid bodies (expect a separate-regions warning)

cases.name: thin_channels
cases.note: fluid fingers 0.02 wide (~2 smallest cells)

cases.name: thin_walls
cases.note: solid fins 0.004 thick (< smallest cell) splitting the fluid

cases.name: tapered_slot
cases.note: fluid slot tapering to a zero-width tip

cases.name: solid_spike
cases.note: solid knife edge jutting into the fluid

cases.name: sliver_cylinder
cases.note: 800 sliver triangles (aspect ratio ~300)

cases.name: dirty_flipped
cases.note: all normals inward: should still mesh

cases.name: dirty_mixed_orient
cases.note: half the triangles flipped: should still mesh

cases.name: dirty_duplicates
cases.note: duplicated and zero-area triangles: should still mesh

cases.name: dirty_edge_touch
cases.note: two boxes sharing one edge (non-manifold edge)

cases.name: dirty_open_box
cases.note: one face missing: must not give a silent mesh

cases.name: dirty_open_box_strict
cases.note: same open box with strictInput: must stop with an error

cases.name: dirty_overlap
cases.note: two overlapping closed spheres (self-intersecting union)
